classification: Read-only OS process-tree sidecar; resource observations, not functional or timing-threshold judgement

sampler_metadata.scope: Observed /proc process tree only, from sampling start. No early-run coverage; no signals or process mutation. PID identity includes starttime. RSS sums double-count shared pages. CPU deltas require consecutive observations; exited/missed processes are not estimated.

sampler_end.coverage_note: Only recorded sample timestamps/CPU intervals are covered; sampler wall duration is not whole-run coverage.

summary.scope_method: CPU is (delta utime+stime)/CLK_TCK divided by observed monotonic interval, 100%=one logical core. Role mean is total observed CPU / total process-interval exposure; p95 uses linear interpolation over observed per-process intervals. Navigation/fault scope uses goal_published to acquisition_finished and excludes CPU intervals crossing either boundary. Group CPU sums observed navigation and planning-worker percentages at each sample. Samples are 1 Hz, not peaks/WCET. RSS/VM are per-process snapshots; summed RSS double-counts shared memory. Windows bracketed by samples do not imply capture of subsecond work or missing first process intervals. UTC labels may be adjusted; all durations use monotonic time.

start_coverage_receipt.events_sha_absent_reason: File is still being appended; final SHA will be collected after run completion.

continuity.error_limit: Census records count only; specific process and error cause are not observed, therefore not inferred.

odom_dropout_boundary.scope: Sampled during standalone odom test, but no complete navigation-window endpoint; excluded from scoped CPU summary and its tail is not covered.

shutdown.exit_health: Separate from function: 18 of 20 Gazebo trials have all 8 launch processes clean; PID single_obstacle_01 gzserver 124411 and single_obstacle_03 gzserver 124819 exit -6 after SIGINT with boost self-join; other 7 in each clean. All localization/joint-state processes clean; standalone odom direct return code not recorded (unknown).

notes: 1 Hz snapshots cannot establish WCET or missing subsecond process work.
CPU 100 percent means one logical CPU; logical CPUs=12.
Summed RSS double-counts shared pages; VM is virtual address space, not physical use.
No missing intervals, transient census failures or post-last-sample tail are imputed.
Unchanged source identity links the independent normal-TF benchmark only; no live performance unknown is overwritten.
